name: Malalich
text: Malalich, also recorded as Samaliliath, belongs to the Partholonians, the first legendary settlers of Ireland. The tradition credits him with bringing the drinking of ale into the country. He also ordained divination, sacrifice, and ritual, which makes him a founder figure for religious practice in the Partholonian account.

attributes.attribute: brought the drinking of ale into Ireland

okr.objective: Documents Malalich as the Partholonian introducer of ale and ritual.
